provenance.what: The module that carries the scoring arithmetic shared between the System One board and this cohort. It is what makes a cohort number and a board number on the same corpus comparable, so its identity is pinned and checked at build time rather than asserted in prose.
provenance.checked_how: build.py hashes the vendored file and aborts if the digest below does not match. Editing the shared arithmetic therefore fails this Space's build until the comparability claim is re-established.

shared_arithmetic.how_it_is_imported: the three scoring scripts put a dev-host working directory on sys.path and import the module from there, so the path in the source is not the repository path
shared_arithmetic.note: An earlier review of this build recorded the module as not vendored, on the strength of the dev-host path in the scoring scripts. That was wrong: the module is in the repository and git-tracked, and the copy the scoring run imported hashes to the same digest.

request_construction.what: The cohort runner imports request construction from the System One reference driver, which is why each row's context digest, context byte count and truncation flag are byte-identical to the settled board rows.
